Official RFC 8785 JCS vectors from
https://github.com/cyberphone/json-canonicalization/tree/master/testdata
(input/*.json and output/*.json), fetched 2026-09-03.

rfc8785-appendix-b.json transcribes RFC 8785 Appendix B (IEEE-754 hex → JSON).
audit-regression.json freezes pre-JCS canonical bytes for ModelBot audit records
(no integer-index object keys; must stay byte-identical; chain v remains 1).
